places.name: Kaleici
places.ai_summary: Kaleici, the Old Town of Antalya, is a charming area with narrow streets, historic buildings, and stunning views of the harbor.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Explore the harbor area for great photo opportunities.

attribution.title: Antalya kaleiçi 2
attribution.author: REHBER0770
attribution.description: A view from Antalya Old Town Marina

places.name: Hadrian's Gate
places.ai_summary: Hadrian's Gate is a well-preserved Roman triumphal arch and a symbol of Antalya's rich history.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Look for the intricate carvings on the arch.

attribution.title: P9271452 Hadrians Gate
attribution.author: Joe Wallace
attribution.description: Built after Hadrian visited Antalya in 130 AD. Last remaining gate in the old walled town and harbour.

places.name: Düden Waterfalls
places.ai_summary: Düden Waterfalls are a stunning natural attraction, with cascading waters and lush greenery, perfect for a relaxing visit.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the afternoon for the best light.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic to enjoy by the falls.

attribution.title: Upper Duden Falls
attribution.author: Saffron Blaze
attribution.description: The upper Düden Waterfall within the City of Antalya, Turkey.

places.name: Aspendos Theatre
places.ai_summary: Aspendos Theatre is one of the best-preserved ancient theatres in the world, still used for performances today.

opening_hours.notes: Check schedule for performance times.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the acoustics demonstration.

attribution.title: Aspendos Amphitheatre
attribution.author: Saffron Blaze
attribution.description:
Aspen dos, present-day Turkey, is known for having the best-preserved theatre of antiquity. With a diametre of 96 metres (315 ft), the theatre provided seating for 7,000.
The theatre was built in 155 AD by the Greek architect Zenon, a native of the city, during the rule of Marcus Aurelius. It was periodically repaired by the Seljuqs, who used it as a caravansary, and in the 13th century the stage building was converted into a palace by the Seljuqs of Rum. Technically the structure is a theatre not an amphitheatre, the latter being full round or oval shaped.

places.name: Perge Ancient City
places.ai_summary: Perge Ancient City is an archaeological site with impressive ruins, including a theatre, stadium, and Roman baths.

opening_hours.notes: Wear comfortable shoes for walking on uneven surfaces.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum on-site for more historical context.

attribution.title: Perge city overview
attribution.author: Saffron Blaze
attribution.description: Roman rule of Perge began in 188 BC, and most of the surviving ruins today date from this period. After the collapse of the Roman Empire, Perge remained inhabited until Seljuk times, before being gradually abandoned.

places.name: Konyaalti Beach
places.ai_summary: Konyaalti Beach is a popular beach destination in Antalya, known for its clear waters and beautiful scenery.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Try the local beachside cafes for fresh seafood.

attribution.title: Falezlerden Antalya Konyaaltı Plajına doğru bir görünüm
attribution.author: Esginmurat
attribution.description: A view taken from the cliffs towards Antalya Konyaaltı Beach in February 2018. The snowy part in the middle is the Bey Mountains and the snowy mountain in the right is Tunç Mountain. The photo is in the west direction. The sea on the left is the Mediterranean.

places.name: Lara Beach
places.ai_summary: Lara Beach is famous for its fine sand and clear waters, offering a range of water sports and activities.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for a quieter experience.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby Düden Park for a complete day out.

places.name: Antalya Museum
places.ai_summary: Antalya Museum is one of Turkey's largest museums, showcasing the region's rich archaeological and cultural history.

opening_hours.notes: Allow at least 2 hours for a thorough visit.

places.place_tip: Check for temporary exhibitions that may be of interest.

attribution.title: Antalya Müzesi (Archäologisches Museum Antalya)
attribution.author: Dat doris
attribution.description: Das Archäologische Museum in Antalya zeigt bedeutende Funde, antike Skulpturen und Bauwerke aus der Region.

places.name: Side Ancient City (Apollon Temple)
places.ai_summary: Side Ancient City is an archaeological site with well-preserved ruins, including the Temple of Apollo and a Roman theatre.

opening_hours.notes: Visit early to avoid the heat and crowds.

places.place_tip: The site is larger than it appears, wear comfortable shoes.

attribution.title: Sunrise apollo side
attribution.author: Saffron Blaze
attribution.description: The ruins of the Temple of Apollo at Side, Antalya, Turkey.

places.name: Termessos Ancient City
places.ai_summary: Termessos Ancient City is a well-preserved ancient city located in the mountains, offering stunning views and a glimpse into the past.

opening_hours.notes: The site is at a high altitude, dress accordingly.

places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks, as facilities are limited.

places.name: Olympos and Çıralı (Chimaera)
places.ai_summary: Olympos and Çıralı are two adjacent sites known for their natural beauty and historical significance, including the eternal flames of Chimaera.

opening_hours.notes: The flames are best seen at night.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a trip to the nearby beach.

attribution.title: Çıralı, Kemer cropped
attribution.author: Alinihatmataraci
attribution.description: View from the Genoese Castle in Olympos, overlooking Çıralı village near Kemer in Antalya, Turkey

places.name: Phaselis Ancient City & Beach
places.ai_summary: Phaselis Ancient City & Beach offers a unique combination of historical ruins and a beautiful beach, perfect for a day of exploration and relaxation.

opening_hours.notes: Bring your own snacks and drinks.

places.place_tip: Explore the ancient ruins before heading to the beach.
places.address: Phaselis Ancient City & Beach, Antalya, Turkey

places.name: Köprülü Canyon National Park (Rafting)
places.ai_summary: Köprülü Canyon National Park is a stunning natural area known for its white-water rafting, hiking trails, and rich biodiversity.

opening_hours.notes: Book rafting tours in advance, especially in summer.

places.place_tip: Wear clothes and shoes that can get wet.
places.address: Köprülü Canyon National Park, Antalya, Turkey

places.name: Saklıkent Gorge
places.ai_summary: Saklıkent Gorge is a breathtaking canyon offering stunning views, hiking opportunities, and a chance to explore ancient ruins.

opening_hours.notes: Bring water and snacks, as facilities are limited.

places.place_tip: The gorge can be slippery, wear appropriate footwear.

places.name: Myra Ancient City (Demre)
places.ai_summary: Myra Ancient City, located in Demre, is famous for its rock-cut tombs and ancient theatre, offering a glimpse into Lycian civilization.

opening_hours.notes: The site is spread out, wear comfortable shoes.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby Demre Museum for more context.
places.address: Myra Ancient City, Demre, Antalya, Turkey

places.name: St. Nicholas Church (Demre)
places.ai_summary: St. Nicholas Church in Demre is an important historical site, known for its beautiful frescoes and as the burial place of St. Nicholas.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the religious significance of the site.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a trip to Myra Ancient City.
places.address: St. Nicholas Church, Demre, Antalya, Turkey

places.name: Kaş
places.ai_summary: Kaş is a charming coastal town known for its beautiful beaches, clear waters, and vibrant nightlife.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for nightlife.

places.place_tip: Explore the old town for unique shops and restaurants.

attribution.title: Kas overview
attribution.author: Wusel007
attribution.description: Kaş from one of the hills east of the city

places.name: Kekova (Sunken City)
places.ai_summary: Kekova, also known as the Sunken City, is a popular destination for its underwater ruins and beautiful bay.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored by boat, consider a boat tour.

places.place_tip: Bring snorkeling gear to explore the underwater ruins.

attribution.title: Kekova island and Kalekoey village
attribution.author: Bjørn Christian Tørrissen
attribution.description: View from the Simena fortress on the hill on the northern side of Kaleköy village, looking south.

places.name: Land of Legends Theme Park
places.ai_summary: Land of Legends Theme Park is a large entertainment complex with a theme park, water park, and shopping avenue.

opening_hours.notes: Check the website for show and event times.

places.place_tip: Arrive early to enjoy all the attractions.
places.address: Land of Legends Theme Park, Antalya, Turkey

places.name: Alanya Castle
places.ai_summary: Alanya Castle is a medieval castle located on a hilltop, offering panoramic views of the Mediterranean and the town of Alanya.

opening_hours.notes: The castle is on a hill, be prepared for a steep walk.

places.place_tip: Visit the Red Tower and the Archaeological Museum nearby.
